name: @bemedev/core-monorepo
description: The core library of @bemedev, providing essential functionalities and utilities for the Bemedev ecosystem.

scripts.ci:
CIN=$(date +%s) && vp install && vp run pretest && vp run lint && vp run test:only && vp run posttest && vp fmt && echo "
✅ CI takes $(($(date +%s) - CIN))s
"
scripts.ci:offline:
CIN=$(date +%s) && vp install --offline && vp run pretest && vp run lint && vp run test:only && vp run posttest && vp fmt && echo "
✅ CI takes $(($(date +%s) - CIN))s
"
scripts.ci:admin:
FULL_CI=$(date +%s) && pnpm run rm && pnpm run up && vp run ci && echo "
✅ Full CI takes $(($(date +%s) - FULL_CI))s
"
scripts.ci:admin:off:
FULL_CI=$(date +%s) && pnpm run rm && pnpm install --offline && vp run ci && echo "
✅ Full CI takes $(($(date +%s) - FULL_CI))s
"
scripts.rinit: vp run rm && vp run config
